name: @data-integrator/runtime-python
description: python runtime image: geospatial stack + job harness

scripts.lock: podman build --build-arg REQUIREMENTS=requirements.in -t localhost/integrator-runtime-python:lock . && (echo '# Generated by pnpm lock from requirements.in; do not edit. numpy and GDAL come from the pinned base image.' && podman run --rm --entrypoint sh localhost/integrator-runtime-python:lock -c 'pip list --format=freeze --path "$(python3 -c "import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_path(\"purelib\", \"posix_local\"))")"') > requirements.txt

author: mWater (https://www.mwater.co)
